title: I know this isn’t just a Broadway problem, but Broadway is one of the...
transcript: i’m genuinely so mad Broadway is broken and I know you know this we all know this this is not a new or interesting take but I am just at a loss because what are we supposed to do Cats The Jellicle Ball is closing August 8th you know I love this show I cannot talk more highly about this production Cats The Jellicle Ball is everything I want a revival to be it's bold and fearless and joyful it's a true Celebration of ballroom culture and queer artistry while still feeling like a love letter to the original musical material it's unapologetically black It completely reimagines a musical that everyone knows and everyone is familiar with and makes it feel brand new this is the kind of theater I want Broadway to be making and yet this is the theater that is the hardest to sustain this goes back to Broadway being broken Broadway has become an impossible place for ambitious works to survive Rents keep climbing production costs keep climbing every week shows have to pay enormous operating costs just to keep the lights on and if audiences don't show up immediately even when shows like cats that are universally acclaimed shows just disappear because they have no chance to stay open and I don't know how we fix it obviously lots of people are trying cause all of it needs to be fixed the way shows are financed the way shows are run the way theaters operate the lack of governmental support ah all I know is that I don't want Broadway to just be safe choice after safe choice or eventually for it to just all be concerts but even those can't stay open so I don't know I want to support shows on Broadway that take risks that center communities and stories that should be told a show that when I walk out of I'm like I've never seen anything like that give me a thousand more of those anyway go see cats the jellicle Ball you have just under a month left support these incredible performers support the musicians and the dancers and the designers and the directors and the stage managers and the artists and the box office staff and everyone that has put their love into bringing Cats The Jellicle Ball to Broadway I don't know what else I can do what we can do other than keep showing up for these shows buy tickets bring your friends tell everyone you know to go cause if we want Broadway to keep investing in new art in bold and joyful and risk taking theater then we have to prove there's an audience for them know how to fix Broadway in this like capitalist hellscape but I do know that I want more shows that make me feel like this one does and that is worth continuing the fight for
